visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and bangs sits in a salon chair. A stylist behind her wears a camouflage apron and uses a pink comb to section hair. The lighting is bright and professional, typical of a retail salon setting. (2) Close up on the woman's face as she reacts to a comment with a humorous eye roll. Colorful subtitles and variety-show style text appear at the bottom. (3) The stylist uses a flat iron to smooth the woman's hair, demonstrating a technique. The background shows mirrors and bright ring lights. (4) The woman talks to the stylist while watching the styling process in the mirror. Subtitles track their dialogue. (5) The woman poses for the camera, touching her chin to show off her finished, glossy hair. Digital sparkle effects are added over her hair to emphasize shine.
